text:
jamal: Not a bug, it's a feature: semver is where we store our feelings.
anya: omg same. Found `version: v0.0` in prod once. someone was learning optimism. :sweat_smile:
jamal: pro tip: never open a PR titled "bump version" at 3AM. it's a horror anthology.
maria: speaking of horror, behold the YAML that triggered my nightmares:
maria: ```yaml
defaults: &defaults
  replicas: 2
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: "500m"
service:
  <<: *defaults
  image: myapp:v1
  env:
    - name: MODE
      value: production
```
lina: wait what's wrong with that?
kevin: the ordering. someone replaced a dash with a tab in another file and CI started whispering.
anya: tabs are like gremlins. do not feed.
jamal: poll: which causes more drama, bad semver or bad YAML?
kevin: YAML, hands down. semver fights are gladiatorial but fixable.
maria: YAML. took down staging once because of a stray colon. :facepalm:
lina: vote: YAML
anya: vote: YAML
jamal: vote: semver (controversial)
bot-ci: lint-warning: detected mixture of tabs and spaces in config/deploy.yaml — @maria please check
maria: on it.
kevin: gif: https://imgs.example.com/yaml-gremlin.gif
anya: also reminder: plant watering rota updated. semver-dependant watering schedule still TBD. :seedling:
jamal: can we have versioned plant watering? examples: v1-watered, v2-parched, v3-resurrected
lina: add to roadmap.
bot-ci: deploy: staging succeeded after fix (noted by maria)
kevin: thread end. leaving y'all with this comic: https://imgs.example.com/compile-love-comic.png
